arxiv-1705-01332.title: LiDAR-based Control of Autonomous Rotorcraft for the Inspection of Pier-like Structures: Proofs
arxiv-1705-01332.creator: Bruno J. Guerreiro, Carlos Silvestre, Rita Cunha, David Cabecinhas
arxiv-1705-01332.description: Abstract This is a complementary document to the paper presented in [ 1 ] , where more detailed proofs are provided for some results. The main paper addresses the problem of trajectory tracking control of autonomous rotorcraft in operation scenarios where only relative position measurements obtained from LiDAR sensors are possible.

arxiv-2101-00318.title: Subtype-aware Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for Medical Diagnosis
arxiv-2101-00318.creator: Xiaofeng Liu, Xiongchang Liu, Bo Hu, Wenxuan Ji, Fangxu Xing, Jun Lu, Jane You, C.-C. Jay Kuo, Georges El Fakhri, Jonghye Woo
arxiv-2101-00318.description: Abstract Recent advances in unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) show that transferable prototypical learning presents a powerful means for class conditional alignment, which encourages the closeness of cross-domain class centroids. However, the cross-domain inner-class compactness and the underlying fine-grained subtype structure remained largely underexplored.

arxiv-2108-03721.title: Mean-square Analysis of the NLMS Algorithm
arxiv-2108-03721.creator: Tareq Y. Al-Naffouri, Muhammad Moinuddin, Anum Ali
arxiv-2108-03721.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Tareq Y. Al-Naffouri, Muhammad Moinuddin, Anum Ali. This work presents a novel approach to the mean-square analysis of the normalized least mean squares (NLMS) algorithm for circular complex colored Gaussian inputs. The analysis is based on the derivation of a closed-form expression for the Cumulative Distribution Function (CDF) of random variables of the form ( ‖ 𝐮 ‖ 𝐃 1 2 ) ​ ( ‖ 𝐮 ‖ 𝐃 2 2 ) − 1 (||{\bf u}||_{{\bf D}_{1}}^{2})(||{\bf u}||_{{\bf D}_{2}}^{2})^{-1} where 𝐮 {\bf u} is an

arxiv-2109-12973.title: Numerical model for 32-bit magnonic ripple carry adder
arxiv-2109-12973.creator: U. Garlando, Q. Wang, O. V. Dobrovolskiy, A. V. Chumak, F. Riente
arxiv-2109-12973.description: Abstract In CMOS-based electronics, the most straightforward way to implement a summation operation is to use the ripple carry adder (RCA). Magnonics, the field of science concerned with data processing by spin-waves and their quanta magnons, recently proposed a magnonic half-adder that can be considered as the simplest magnonic integrated circuit.

arxiv-2112-13475.title: When Scattering Transform Meets Non-Gaussian Random Processes, a Double Scaling Limit Result
arxiv-2112-13475.creator: Gi-Ren Liu, Yuan-Chung Sheu, Hau-Tieng Wu
arxiv-2112-13475.description: Abstract We explore the finite dimensional distributions of the second-order scattering transform of a class of non-Gaussian processes when all the scaling parameters go to infinity simultaneously. For frequently used wavelets, we find a coupling rule for the scale parameters of the wavelet transform within the first and second layers such that the limit exists.

arxiv-2204-05621.title: Phase transition and entropic force in Reissner-Nordström-de Sitter spacetime
arxiv-2204-05621.creator: Yang Zhang, Yu-bo Ma, Yun-zhi Du, Huai-fan Li, Li-chun Zhang
arxiv-2204-05621.description: Abstract In this paper, thermodynamic properties of the Reissner-Nordström-de Sitter (RN-dS) black hole have been studied on the basis of the correlation between the black hole and cosmological horizons. It is found that the RN-dS black hole experiences a phase transition, when its state parameters satisfy certain conditions.

arxiv-2207-08218.title: Thermodynamic bounds for diffusion in non-equilibrium systems with multiple timescales
arxiv-2207-08218.creator: A. Plati, A. Puglisi, A. Sarracino
arxiv-2207-08218.description: Abstract We derive a Thermodynamic Uncertainty Relation bounding the mean squared displacement of a Gaussian process with memory, driven out of equilibrium by unbalanced thermal baths and/or by external forces. Our bound is tighter with respect to previous results and also holds at finite time.

arxiv-2310-06271.title: Towards Mitigating Hallucination in Large Language Models via Self-Reflection
arxiv-2310-06271.creator: Ziwei Ji, Tiezheng Yu, Yan Xu, Nayeon Lee, Etsuko Ishii, Pascale Fung
arxiv-2310-06271.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise for generative and knowledge-intensive tasks including question-answering (QA) tasks. However, the practical deployment still faces challenges, notably the issue of "hallucination", where models generate plausible-sounding but unfaithful or nonsensical information. This issue becomes particularly critical in the medical domain due to the uncommon professional concepts and potential social risks involved.

arxiv-2310-09205.title: On Félix–Tanré rational models for polyhedral products
arxiv-2310-09205.creator: Katsuhiko KURIBAYASHI
arxiv-2310-09205.description: Abstract . The Félix–Tanré rational model for the polyhedral product of a fibre inclusion is considered. In particular, we investigate the rational model for the polyhedral product of a pair of Lie groups corresponding to arbitrary simplicial complex and the rational homotopy group of the polyhedral product.

arxiv-2401-18035.title: Optimizing contrastive learning for cortical folding pattern detection
arxiv-2401-18035.creator: Aymeric Gaudin, Louise Guillon, Clara Fischer, Arnaud Cachia, Denis Rivière, Jean-François Mangin, Joël Chavas
arxiv-2401-18035.description: Abstract The human cerebral cortex has many bumps and grooves called gyri and sulci. Even though there is a high inter-individual consistency for the main cortical folds, this is not the case when we examine the exact shapes and details of the folding patterns.

arxiv-2403-18392.title: Broad-band ellipsometry study of the anisotropic dielectric response of YAlO 3 {}_{\text{3}}
arxiv-2403-18392.creator: Laurent Bugnon, Christian Bernhard, Premysl Marsik
arxiv-2403-18392.description: Abstract We present a broad band (THz to UV) ellipsometry study of the anisotropic dielectric response of the orthorhombic perovskite YAlO 3 {}_{\text{3}} . The ellipsometric measurements have been performed on YAlO 3 {}_{\text{3}} crystals with three different surface cuts and for six high symmetry configurations of the crystal axes with respect to the plane of incidence of the photons.

arxiv-2404-08611.title: Automatic Quantification of Serial PET/CT Images for Pediatric Hodgkin Lymphoma Patients Using a Longitudinally-Aware Segmentation Network
arxiv-2404-08611.creator: Xin Tie, Muheon Shin, Changhee Lee, Scott B. Perlman, Zachary Huemann, Amy J. Weisman, Sharon M. Castellino, Kara M. Kelly, Kathleen M. McCarten, Adina L. Alazraki, Junjie Hu, Steve Y. Cho, Tyler J. Bradshaw
arxiv-2404-08611.description: Abstract Purpose : Automatic quantification of longitudinal changes in PET scans for lymphoma patients has proven challenging, as residual disease in interim-therapy scans is often subtle and difficult to detect. Our goal was to develop a longitudinally-aware segmentation network (LAS-Net) that can quantify serial PET/CT images for pediatric Hodgkin lymphoma patients.

arxiv-2407-16088.title: Benamou-Brenier Formulation of Optimal Transport for Nonlinear Control Systems on ℝ d \mathbb{R}^{d}
arxiv-2407-16088.creator: Karthik Elamvazhuthi
arxiv-2407-16088.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Karthik Elamvazhuthi. In this paper we consider the Benamou-Brenier formulation of optimal transport for nonlinear control affine systems on ℝ d \mathbb{R}^{d} , removing the compactness assumption of the underlying manifold in previous work by the author. By using Bernard’s Young measure based weak formulation of optimal transport, the results are established for cases not covered by previous treatments using the Monge problem. Particularly, no assumptions are made on the non-existence of singular minimizing controls or the cost function being Lipschitz.

arxiv-2409-02641.title: Mid-IR chirality and chiral thermal emission through twisting
arxiv-2409-02641.creator: Michael T. Enders, Mitradeep Sarkar, Evgenia Klironomou, Michela Florinda Picardi, Riccardo Bertini, Aleksandra Deeva, Georgia T. Papadakis
arxiv-2409-02641.description: Abstract Chirality in the mid-infrared spectral range plays a crucial role across physical, chemical, and biological sciences, yet sources of chiral infrared light do not currently exist. Their development, using principles from the mature field of metamaterials, requires complex three-dimensional architectures that call for high-resolution lithography.

arxiv-2506-20979.title: 3D Scene-Camera Representation with Joint Camera Photometric Optimization
arxiv-2506-20979.creator: Weichen Dai Kangcheng Ma, Jiaxin Wang, Kecen Pan, Yuhang Ming, Hua Zhang, Wanzeng Kong
arxiv-2506-20979.description: Abstract Representing scenes from multi-view images is a crucial task in computer vision with extensive applications. However, inherent photometric distortions in the camera imaging can significantly degrade image quality. Without accounting for these distortions, the 3D scene representation may inadvertently incorporate erroneous information unrelated to the scene, diminishing the quality of the representation.

arxiv-2507-08640.title: Upper tail distributions of central L L -values of quadratic twists of elliptic curves at the variance scale
arxiv-2507-08640.creator: Nathan Creighton
arxiv-2507-08640.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Nathan Creighton. We consider the large deviations at the order of the variance for the central value of a family of L L -functions among the members with bounded discriminant. When there is an upper bound on an integer moment of the central value twisted by a short Dirichlet polynomial, we can establish upper bounds on the density of members exhibiting a large central value.

pmc-11331321.title: Comparative efficacy of proximal femoral nail vs dynamic condylar screw in treating unstable intertrochanteric fractures
pmc-11331321.creator: Ahmed Mohamed Yousif Mohamed, Monzir Salih, Mohanad Abdulgadir, Ayman E Abbas, Duha Lutfi Turjuman
pmc-11331321.description: BACKGROUNDAmong the most frequent hip fractures are trochanteric fractures, which usually occur from low-energy trauma like minor falls, especially in older people with osteoporotic bones.AIMTo evaluate the treatment efficacy of dynamic condylar screws (DCS) and proximal femoral nails (PFN) for unstable intertrochanteric fractures.

pmc-11506552.title: Efficacy of Atezolizumab Plus Bevacizumab–Transcatheter Arterial Chemoembolization Sequential Therapy for Patients with Intermediate-Stage Hepatocellular Carcinoma
pmc-11506552.creator: Etsuko Moriyama, Shigeo Shimose, Takashi Niizeki, Hideki Iwamoto, Masatoshi Tanaka, Tomotake Shirono, Yu Noda, Masahito Nakano, Ryoko Kuromatsu, Hironori Koga, Takumi Kawaguchi
pmc-11506552.description: This retrospective study aimed to evaluate the impact of atezolizumab plus bevacizumab–transcatheter arterial chemoembolization (TACE) sequential therapy in unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), especially in patients with intermediate-stage HCC. A total of 212 patients were enrolled and categorized into the Atez/Bev-TACE sequential therapy (n = 23) or Atez/Bev monotherapy group (n = 189) between 2020 and 2024.

pmc-11543537.title: ViT-HHO: Optimized vision transformer for diabetic retinopathy detection using Harris Hawk optimization
pmc-11543537.creator: Vishal Awasthi, Namita Awasthi, Hemant Kumar, Shubhendra Singh, Prabal Pratap Singh, Poonam Dixit, Rashi Agarwal
pmc-11543537.description: Diabetic retinopathy (DR) is a significant cause of vision impairment globally, emphasizing the importance of timely and precise detection to prevent severe consequences. This study presents an optimized Vision Transformer (ViT) model that incorporates Harris Hawk Optimization (HHO) to improve the automated detection of diabetic retinopathy (DR).

pmc-11596926.title: Critical Assessment of Fellowship Director Gender and Ethnic Diversity across the Five Major Plastic Surgery Fellowships
pmc-11596926.creator: Sam Boroumand, Sasha Stogniy, Beatrice Katsnelson, Omar Allam, Aliyar Zahedi Vafa, Janessa Sullivan, Bohdan Pomahac, Siba Haykal, Paris D. Butler
pmc-11596926.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background:Subspecialty fellowship directors are essential to the selection and mentorship of trainees. The purpose of this study is to evaluate the gender and racial/ethnic diversity of fellowship directors across fellowship programs in plastic and reconstructive surgery (PRS).Methods:In December 2023, listings of fellowship programs/directors were surveyed from respective professional society websites across the 5 primary PRS fellowships: hand (American Society for Surgery of the Hand), craniofacial (American Society of Craniofacial Surgeons), microsurgery (American Society for Reconstructive Microsurgery), aesthetic (The Aesthetic Society), and burn

pmc-11604313.title: Examining the effectiveness of promotional nudges increasing plant-based food choices in a post-secondary education dining hall: a pilot study
pmc-11604313.creator: Jennifer Joy Anderson, Andy Bains, Julie Stachiw, Alexandra J Heidl, Tamara Paetsch, Tamara R Cohen
pmc-11604313.description: Objective:To evaluate nudge strategies that increase the consumption of plant-based foods, defined as vegetarian or vegan food items, compared with meat-based options in post-secondary dining hall settings.Design:A pilot study.Setting:This study took place in the University of British Columbia Vancouver Campus’s Gather Dining Hall (GDH) over a 6-week intervention period and two control periods.

pmc-12513849.title: Investigation of the Effects of Different Home Frying Methods (Air Fryer and Deep Fryer) on HMF and Aroma Compounds in Gluten‐Free Bean Chips
pmc-12513849.creator: Ali Göncü
pmc-12513849.description: The aim of this study was to produce functional gluten‐free chips with red and black bean flour substitutes using different household frying devices (deep fat fryer and hot air fryer) and to determine the flavor components and 5‐hydroxymethylfurfural (HMF) released during the production of these chips.

pmc-12768650.title: PP82 Environmental Sustainability Assessment Across The Medical Device Life Cycle: Taking The Viewpoint Of Low Resource Settings
pmc-12768650.creator: Debjani Mueller, Melissa Pegg, Abhirup Dutta Majumdar
pmc-12768650.description: IntroductionGlobally, healthcare services contribute five percent of total greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions. Advances in biomedical research have led to innovative technologies, but the use of fossil fuel reliant products is a critical environmental issue. The burden is even greater in low resource settings (LRS) with increasing waste management issues.

pmc-12831356.title: Impact of a two-phase robotic-assisted and home-based training program on falls and fall risk in older adults: a multicenter randomized controlled trial
pmc-12831356.creator: Eunyoung Kwag, Alice De Luca, Giorgia Marchesi, Valentina Squeri, Philipp Ramm, Martin Hochheim, Max Wunderlich, Wiebren Zijlstra, Tobias Morat
pmc-12831356.description: BackgroundFalls in older adults represent a significant health risk, and technology-supported interventions have emerged as a potential training solution to reduce fall risk. However, the effectiveness and applicability of such interventions require further evaluation. This study aimed to assess the impact of a novel technology-supported fall prevention program on fall incidence, fall risk, acceptability, and feasibility in community-dwelling older adults.

pmc-13115855.title: Bronchial and Systemic Relationships of Haemophilus in Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease
pmc-13115855.creator: Eduard Monsó, Carme Casadevall, Sara Quero, Sergi Pascual-Guàrdia, César Jésse Enríquez-Rodríguez, Laura Millares, Concepción Montón, Rosa Faner, Silvia Capilla, Luis Miguel Seijo, Ady Castro-Acosta, Carlos Alvarez-Martínez, Oriol Sibila, Germán Peces-Barba, Borja G. Cosio, Alvar Agustí, Joaquim Gea
pmc-13115855.description: The aim of the study was to assess the microbial composition of bronchial secretions in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), focusing on the impact of the exacerbation patterns on the common components of the respiratory flora and their relationship with inflammatory proteins.

pmc-13279690.title: Italian guidelines for the use of digital breast tomosynthesis in breast cancer screening programmes: GRADE-ADOLOPMENT of the European guidelines
pmc-13279690.creator: Francesco Venturelli, Silvia Deandrea, Paola Mantellini, Eugenio Paci, Marco Zappa, Martina Rossi, Massimo Calabrese, Francesca Battisti, Lauro Bucchi, Priscilla Sassoli de’ Bianchi, Francesca Caumo, Carlo Senore, Adriana Bonifacino, Flori Degrassi, Valeria Fava, Elisa Betti, Riccardo Vecchio, Andre
pmc-13279690.description: To enhance the quality of organized mammographic screening in Italy, in accordance with national legislation, a multidisciplinary panel of experts applied the Grading of Recommendations, Assessment, Development and Evaluation (GRADE)-ADOLOPMENT approach to adopt or adapt the European Commission Initiative on Breast Cancer (ECIBC) guidelines concerning the use of digital breast tomosynthesis (DBT).

pmc-13424557.title: Transcriptomic and RNAi-mediated antiviral response to Kamiti River virus infection in Aedes albopictus U4.4 cells
pmc-13424557.creator: Pontus Öhlund, Marlene Cavaleiro Pinto, Anne-Lie Blomström
pmc-13424557.description: Mosquitoes transmit arboviruses that represent major global public health challenges. Increasing insecticide resistance and absence of effective antiviral therapies underscore the need for novel vector control strategies. Insect-specific viruses have emerged as candidates for biological control, however, the cellular mechanisms underlying their interactions with mosquito hosts remain poorly understood. Here, we examined the immune response of Aedes albopictus U4.

pmc-13453766.title: Beyond pharmacotherapy: a narrative review of patient, social, and healthcare system factors influencing treatment adherence in ankylosing spondylitis
pmc-13453766.creator: Yao Wang, Lifei Feng, Xiaoqiu Zhu, Miaomiao Zhang

pmc-13459272.title: Clinical characteristics of pure menstrual migraine and menstrually-related migraine: a cross-sectional online questionnaire study
pmc-13459272.creator: Yanyan Zhou, Quanquan Zhang, Tian Xia, Mengyi Guo, Hongru Zhao
pmc-13459272.description: BackgroundMigraine is a highly prevalent neurological disorder which is more common in women. Clinically, there are two subtypes of menstrual migraine, including pure menstrual migraine (PMM) and menstrually-related migraine (MRM). The former experiences migraine attacks only during the perimenstrual period, while the latter experiences migraine attacks during the perimenstrual period and at other times of the menstrual cycle.

pmc-13552058.title: Functional Outcomes of Surgical Management of Posterior Wall Acetabular Fractures: A Prospective Study
pmc-13552058.creator: Rajesh Senapati, Alok Sahu, Debashish Meher, Hemanth Raj
pmc-13552058.description: Introduction:Around 10% of the pelvic injuries involve acetabulum and approximately one-third of the acetabular fractures involve the posterior wall. These fractures are difficult to treat due to the complex three-dimensional (3D) anatomy, limitations of the surgical approaches due to important structures surrounding the acetabulum and extensive dissection of the large muscles around the hip.

pmc-13608030.title: Nasal Cytology in Precision Rhinology: From Local Cellular Phenotyping to Personalized Management of Nasal Inflammatory Diseases
pmc-13608030.creator: Matteo Gelardi
pmc-13608030.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Nasal cytology provides a direct and minimally invasive assessment of the cellular environment of the nasal mucosa and may represent a valuable tool within the emerging framework of precision rhinology. Beyond its traditional diagnostic role, cytological examination can identify distinct local inflammatory patterns characterized by neutrophils, eosinophils, mast cells, and mixed cellular profiles, thereby revealing biological heterogeneity that may not be fully captured by clinical phenotype or systemic biomarkers alone.

the-mystery-of-murray-davenport-a-story-.creator: Robert Neilson Stephens
